headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 30, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins secured a thrilling 8-6 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Griffin Conine leading the offense with a home run and 2 RBIs. In other action, the Arizona Diamondbacks shut out the Pittsburgh Pirates 3-0 behind Eduardo Rodriguez's strong performance on the mound. The Toronto Blue Jays took down the Washington Nationals 5-2, with Kazuma Okamoto contributing 3 hits and 2 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. The Texas Rangers placed Jakob Junis on the 15-day injured list due to a left adductor strain. The Rangers also transferred Jose Corniell to the 60-day injured list and Danny Jansen to the 60-day injured list. The Minnesota Twins placed Byron Buxton on the 10-day injured list with a right hip impingement. The Tampa Bay Rays placed Cole Sulser on the 15-day injured list with lower back spasms.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place. The Detroit Tigers traded catcher Jake Rogers to the Baltimore Orioles for right-hander Zane Barnhart. The Los Angeles Angels traded catcher Logan O'Hoppe and right-hander Chase Silseth to the Texas Rangers for shortstop Angel Arredondo. The Baltimore Orioles traded right fielder Johnathan Rodríguez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash. The San Diego Padres signed shortstop Nu'u Contrades.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Phillies in Thrilling 8-6 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a hard-fought win against the Philadelphia Phillies, ultimately emerging victorious 8-6. Griffin Conine led the Marlins' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Shut Out Pirates 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks secured a shutout victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Eduardo Rodriguez leading the way on the mound. Rodriguez pitched 8.0 innings, allowing 0 earned runs and striking out 2 batters.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Nationals 5-2**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 5-2 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Kazuma Okamoto leading the offense with 3 hits and 2 RBIs. Trey Yesavage earned the win with 6.2 innings pitched, striking out 4 and allowing 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Orioles Edge Tigers in Thrilling 10-9 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a hard-fought 10-9 win over the Detroit Tigers, coming out on top in a back-and-forth contest. Grant Wolfram earned the win for the Orioles, while Andrew Kittredge secured the save.

top_news.title: **Rays Edge Rangers in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 3-2 victory over the Texas Rangers in a closely contested matchup. Impact hitters for the Rays included Yandy Díaz and Cedric Mullins, while Jonny DeLuca also made a notable contribution.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Royals in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins edged out the Kansas City Royals 4-3 in a closely contested game, securing their win. Impact players for the Twins included John Rave and Cole Sands, while Noah Cameron stood out on the mound.

top_news.title: **Rangers' Junis Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Jakob Junis, a right-handed pitcher for the Texas Rangers, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left adductor strain. The move is retroactive to July 29, 2026.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire RHP Zane Barnhart in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring right-handed pitcher Zane Barnhart from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for catcher Jake Rogers.
